tone: Use clear, approachable Brazilian Portuguese with consistent neutral address.
capitalization: Use sentence case and Brazilian Portuguese capitalization conventions.
button_labels: Use concise familiar action verbs and omit terminal punctuation.
ui_roles: Keep labels concise, buttons action-oriented, tooltips explanatory, and warnings or errors as natural complete sentences.
technical_terms: Use established Brazilian software terms and preserve glossary tokens verbatim.
contextual_terminology: Resolve ambiguous terms from the feature, stable ID, surface type, and neighboring strings instead of enforcing one translation globally.
punctuation: Apply Brazilian punctuation conventions without changing accelerators or syntax tokens.
units: Use metric conventions and Brazilian decimal formatting when context requests formatting.
natural_language: Use idiomatic Brazilian Portuguese rather than European variants or literal calques.
